action.query:
SELECT CITY, COUNT(ORDER_ID) AS ORDER_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN IS_CANCELLED THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CANCELLED_COUNT, AVG(CASE WHEN IS_CANCELLED THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CANCELLATION_RATE
FROM ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER
WHERE ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY CITY
HAVING COUNT(ORDER_ID) >= 50000
ORDER BY CANCELLATION_RATE DESC, ORDER_COUNT DESC
LIMIT 1;
